BiblicalUsage: Aziel was a Levite musician, one of those who played the harps on Alamoth before the ark when David brought it up to Jerusalem. He appears once, in the list of the singers, and his harp is his whole story.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the harp matters as much as the sword in God's kingdom, and Aziel played his part in the day the ark came home.
